prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached existing game obstacle sprite. Create a soft natural ground transition for placement on a warm muted beige map floor. Preserve EXACT original canvas, core position, core shape, orientation, camera, interior objects and their pixel scale. Change ONLY the perimeter: completely remove the continuous dark purple polygon outline. Replace the abrupt straight cut edge of the soil with an irregular broken brush-painted transition, transitioning through sparse debris and decreasing opacity into true transparency within approximately 40–70 source pixels. Keep a readable dense obstacle core. Allow a narrow visual skirt outside the old footprint, preserve generous transparent canvas padding. Royal ward paving: erode the outermost slab ends into little stone fragments and dust; blue light should diminish subtly near the outermost fragments. Keep all existing diamonds the same small size. Stylized hand-painted storybook game art, muted colours. No continuous ring or rim, no broad fog halo, no added platform height, no background, no text, no checkerboard. True alpha transparency including semi-transparent transition pixels.
constraints: fixed authored orientation and footprint size; no random rotation or scale
soft-edge variant keeps its core footprint scale
